visualReview.method: All seven source images opened individually. Every slide rendered in Chromium, then source and final result opened side by side per slide; three render/review rounds total.

found: Shared renderer omitted chip border strokes.
Zero-height horizontal line nodes did not render, affecting screw slots, company fact separators, pyramid leader lines.
Display heading spacing and width differed.
Simple Lucide slide 7 icons lacked reference details.
fixed: Reported shared renderer bugs to root; fixes integrated.
Adjusted display text dimensions, font weight, letter spacing, and baseline.

found: Korean slide headings included extra spaces.
Simple icons in strategy flow were visually too sparse.
fixed: Drew editable line vectors for document/pencil, hand/lightbulb, checklist and moneybag symbols.

found: Font family in source is not declared; rendered Korean glyph and Latin letter shapes differ slightly from image.
Small gray support text and a few labels differ by a few pixels.
roundNotes.decision: Accepted within three-round review limit; no clipping, canvas overflow or font loading failures remain.

decisions: All content remained editable text, geometry, icons and inline SVG; no original reference was used as slide background.
Readable original text transcribed; no invented unreadable text was needed.
Shared frame, highlight, pill, diagram and flow-card helper functions provide reusable construction.
No photographic placeholders were needed for this deck, which consists of editable shapes and text.
knownDifferences: Pretendard is loaded as a real variable font, but exact source font is unknown.
Some source pictograms were redrawn with simple vector strokes, retaining content and position.
